infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Shows family events next to the work and personal calendars you choose, and adds family events to your Calendar. Your work events stay on your phone unless you choose to share them.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Keeps family reminders in sync with Apple Reminders so Siri can use them.
infoPlist.NSSiriUsageDescription: Lets you add reminders and hear today’s plan with Siri.

plugins.calendarPermission: Shows family events next to the work and personal calendars you choose, and adds family events to your Calendar. Your work events stay on your phone unless you choose to share them.
plugins.remindersPermission: Keeps your family reminders in step with Apple Reminders, so “Hey Siri, remind me…” lands in the right list.
